dedupe_keys.name: muk3d tailings and earthworks modelling software

description: Commercial 3D software for designing tailings facilities and earthworks. The Muk3D home page describes advanced earthworks and tailings modelling software used to create dams, dumps, excavations and tailings constructions and to build tailings deposition plans. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): commercial licence (Muk3D). Access is paid. Coverage is any site the user models. Caveats: the page read does not list file formats or the deposition methods supported in detail. For simulation it gives the changing geometry of a tailings facility over its life, the storage and beach shape needed for water balance and dam breach studies, and GoldSim lists a technical paper on 3D deposition and water balance modelling with Muk3D and GoldSim. A related catalogue record is GoldSim for mine water and waste management.
